_pass_criteria_help: Each key must match a key in the 'metrics' dict returned by checks.py.
Simple form (number) — higher is better, uses >= comparison:
Object form — for metrics where lower is better or exact match:
Supported comparisons: gte (>=), gt (>), lte (<=), lt (<), eq (==)
Default comparison when using simple form: gte (>=)

attempts.architecture: Model architecture used (e.g., regularized logistic classifier with feature selection).
attempts.augmentations: Data processing or augmentation applied (e.g., signed/unsigned edge channel separation, StandardScaler, SelectKBest).
